title: [Updated 10/22] Choose Your Ruleset in World of Warcraft: Forever
author: Blizzard Entertainment

short_news.title_en: [Updated 10/22] Choose Your Ruleset in World of Warcraft: Forever

path: Choose the Ruleset That Fits Your Journey
changes.text: Normal: The baseline World of Warcraft experience, where players can focus on exploration, questing, cooperation, and player-versus-player combat when they choose to engage in it.

path: Choose the Ruleset That Fits Your Journey
changes.text: PvP: For players who want every trip into contested territory to carry more danger, excitement, and open-world conflict.

path: Choose the Ruleset That Fits Your Journey
changes.text: Roleplaying: For players who want to lean more deeply into the fantasy of Azeroth and seek out like-minded adventurers.

path: Choose the Ruleset That Fits Your Journey
changes.text: Hardcore: For players seeking the ultimate challenge, where every decision matters and death carries lasting consequences. (Hardcore will be available sometime after launch.)

Factions also remain separate. Horde and Alliance players still cannot group together, preserving the faction boundaries that remain core to the World of Warcraft: Forever experience and maintaining the “war” in Warcraft.

Collections and Legacy Points are account-wide across rulesets, with Hardcore handled differently. Progress, collections, and rewards earned in Hardcore can become available elsewhere, but progress from other rulesets will not flow back into Hardcore. This keeps Hardcore distinct while still allowing players to carry accomplishments forward if they move out of it.

path: A Larger World That Still Feels Familiar
changes.text: The realmless structure is meant to reduce the pressure of choosing the right launch realm without turning Azeroth into a place that feels anonymous. As players level, quest, gather, and explore within their chosen ruleset, the world around them should still feel active and lived in—filled with organic encounters, unexpected rivalries, moments of cooperation, and the kind of shared experiences that make each journey feel rooted in Azeroth.
